```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(DescTools)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```

Loading and preparing the data

```{r}

data_paxis <- read.csv("data_paxis.csv")
data_type_paxis <- read.csv("data_type_paxis.csv")
data_pamp <- read.csv("data_pamp.csv")
data_type_pamp <- read.csv("data_type_pamp.csv")

#====== PAXIS COFFEE INTAKE ======

# Comprehensive data preprocessing
data_paxis <- data_paxis %>% filter(CAUSE == 1 | MORTSTAT == 0)
data_paxis <- data_paxis %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert character variables to numeric
    MORTSTAT = as.numeric(MORTSTAT),
    
    # Enhanced coffee categorization
    coffee_category = case_when(
      COFFEE == 0 ~ "None",
      COFFEE > 0 & COFFEE <= 30 ~ "Low (1-30)",
      COFFEE > 30 & COFFEE <= 99 ~ "Moderate (30-99)",
      COFFEE > 99 ~ "High (>99)"
    ),
    coffee_category = factor(coffee_category, 
                           levels = c("None", "Low (1-30)", "Moderate (30-99)", "High (>99)")),
    
    # Binary coffee consumption
    coffee_binary = factor(ifelse(COFFEE > 0, "Coffee Drinker", "Non-Drinker"),
                          levels = c("Non-Drinker", "Coffee Drinker")),
    
    # Enhanced caffeine categorization
    caffeine_category = case_when(
      CAFFEINE == 0 ~ "None",
      CAFFEINE > 0 & CAFFEINE <= 100 ~ "Low (1-100mg)",
      CAFFEINE > 100 & CAFFEINE <= 300 ~ "Moderate (101-300mg)",
      CAFFEINE > 300 ~ "High (>300mg)"
    ),
    caffeine_category = factor(caffeine_category, 
                             levels = c("None", "Low (1-100mg)", "Moderate (101-300mg)", 
                                      "High (>300mg)")),
    
    # Enhanced smoking categorization
    smoking_status = case_when(
      CIGARETTES == 0 ~ "Non-smoker",
      CIGARETTES > 0 & CIGARETTES <= 10 ~ "Light (1-10/day)",
      CIGARETTES > 10 & CIGARETTES <= 20 ~ "Moderate (11-20/day)",
      CIGARETTES > 20 ~ "Heavy (>20/day)"
    ),
    smoking_status = factor(smoking_status, 
                          levels = c("Non-smoker", "Light (1-10/day)", 
                                   "Moderate (11-20/day)", "Heavy (>20/day)")),
    
    # Physical activity groups
    activity_level = case_when(
      ACTIVE == 2 ~ "Inactive",
      ACTIVE == 1 | ACTIVE == 3 ~ "Active"
    ),
    activity_level = factor(activity_level, levels = c("Inactive", "Active")),
    
    # Convert other categorical variables
    SEX = factor(SEX, labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    RACE = factor(RACE, labels = c("White", "Black", "Other")),
    HYPERTENSION = factor(HYPERTENSION, 
                         levels = c(2, 1),
                         labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    DIABETES = factor(DIABETES,
                     levels = c(2, 1),
                     labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    
    # Mortality status as factor
    MORTALITY_STATUS = factor(MORTSTAT, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Alive", "Dead")),
    
    
    # Combined risk score (simplified)
    risk_score = (as.numeric(HYPERTENSION == "Yes") + 
                  as.numeric(DIABETES == "Yes") + 
                  as.numeric(CIGARETTES > 0) + 
                  as.numeric(AGE > 65)),
    
      risk_category = case_when(
        risk_score <= 1 ~ "Low risk",
        risk_score == 2 ~ "Moderate risk",
        risk_score >= 3 ~ "High risk"
      )
    )

                     labels = c("No", "Yes")),
```

ANOVA for different caffeine intake categories against age of death (individuals with abnormal P wave axis).

```{r}

# Filtrar apenas indivíduos que morreram
mortos <- data_paxis %>% filter(!is.na(AGE.DEATH))

# ANOVA
anova_model <- aov(AGE.DEATH ~ caffeine_category, data = mortos)
summary(anova_model)

# Teste de Tukey HSD
TukeyHSD(anova_model)

# Gráfico boxplot
ggplot(mortos, aes(x = caffeine_category, y = AGE.DEATH)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Age at death per caffeine category",
       x = "Caffeine category",
       y = "Age at death") +
  theme_minimal()

# Kruskal–Wallis test
kruskal.test(AGE.DEATH ~ caffeine_category, data = data_paxis)

pairwise.wilcox.test(data_paxis$AGE.DEATH,
                     data_paxis$caffeine_category,
                     p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")

```

Survival analysis for different caffeine intake categories adjusted to confounding variables (individuals with abnormal P wave axis).

```{r}
# Survival object
surv_obj <- Surv(time = data_paxis$TIME, event = data_paxis$MORTSTAT)

# Fit survival curves by caffeine category
fit_km <- survfit(surv_obj ~ caffeine_category, data = data_paxis)


# Cox model multivariat (adjusted to age, sex, etc.)
cox_multi <- coxph(Surv(TIME, MORTSTAT) ~ caffeine_category + smoking_status + activity_level + AGE + SEX + DIABETES + HYPERTENSION,
                   data = data_paxis)
summary(cox_multi)

new_data <- data.frame(
  caffeine_category = levels(data_paxis$caffeine_category),
  smoking_status = "Non-smoker",
  activity_level = "Inactive",
  AGE = mean(data_paxis$AGE, na.rm = TRUE),
  SEX = "Male",
  DIABETES = "No",
  HYPERTENSION = "No"
)

# Survival curve for each group
fit_cox <- survfit(cox_multi, newdata = new_data)

# Log-rank test
logrank_test <- survdiff(surv_obj ~ caffeine_category, data = data_paxis)

logrank_test

# Plot
ggsurvplot(fit_km,
           data = data_paxis,
           pval = TRUE,
           conf.int = TRUE,
           risk.table = TRUE,
           xlab = "Time (months)",
           ylab = "Survival probability",
           legend.title = "Caffeine category",
           legend.labs = c("None", "Low", "Moderate", "High"))

ggsurvplot(fit_cox,
           data = new_data,
           conf.int = TRUE,
           risk.table = TRUE,
           legend.title = "Caffeine category",
           legend.labs = c("None", "Low", "Moderate", "High"),
           xlab = "Time (months)",
           ylab = "Survival probability")
```

```{r}
ggsurvplot(fit_cox,
           data = new_data,
           conf.int = TRUE,
           risk.table = TRUE,
           legend.title = "Coffee consumption category",
           legend.labs = c("None", "Low", "Moderate", "High"),
           xlab = "Time (months)",
           ylab = "Survival probability")
```

Survival analysis for different coffee types categories adjusted to confounding variables (individuals with abnormal negative P wave amplitude).

```{r}
# Survival object
surv_obj <- Surv(time = data_type_pamp$TIME, event = data_type_pamp$MORTSTAT)

# Fit survival curves by coffee type category
fit_km <- survfit(surv_obj ~ coffee_type_category, data = data_type_pamp)


# Cox model multivariat (adjusted to age, sex, etc.)
cox_multi <- coxph(Surv(TIME, MORTSTAT) ~ coffee_type_category + smoking_status + activity_level + AGE + SEX + DIABETES + HYPERTENSION,
                   data = data_type_pamp)
summary(cox_multi)

new_data <- data.frame(
  coffee_type_category = levels(data_type_pamp$coffee_type_category),
  smoking_status = "Non-smoker",
  activity_level = "Inactive",
  AGE = mean(data_type_pamp$AGE, na.rm = TRUE),
  SEX = "Male",
  DIABETES = "No",
  HYPERTENSION = "No"
)

# Survival curve for each group
fit_cox <- survfit(cox_multi, newdata = new_data)

# Log-rank test
logrank_test <- survdiff(surv_obj ~ coffee_type_category, data = data_type_pamp)

logrank_test

# Plot
ggsurvplot(fit_km,
           data = data_type_pamp,
           pval = TRUE,
           conf.int = TRUE,
           risk.table = TRUE,
           xlab = "Time (months)",
           ylab = "Survival probability",
           legend.title = "Coffee type category",
           legend.labs = c("Decaffeinated", "Caffeinated", "Both"))

ggsurvplot(fit_cox,
           data = new_data,
           conf.int = TRUE,
           risk.table = TRUE,
           legend.title = "Coffee type category",
           legend.labs = c("Decaffeinated", "Caffeinated", "Both"),
           xlab = "Time (months)",
           ylab = "Survival probability")
```
